stem: At a Massachusetts pharmacy, an adult's first outpatient tramadol prescription for acute pain requests a 10-day supply without exception documentation. What should be resolved?

choices.text: Apply only the five-refill and six-month Schedule IV limits.
Allow ten days because Schedule IV drugs are exempt from the opiate statute.
Reduce the quantity without contacting the prescriber and discard the balance.
Use the seven-day restriction only for patients younger than 18.
Resolve the Massachusetts initial-opiate seven-day limit before dispensing the requested quantity.
